newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,265 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,265 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,265 contracts compared with 858 overnight Wednesday.
There were 194 wheat, 256 corn, 727 soybean, 80 soymeal and eight soyoil contracts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was four to 5-1/4 cents lower, corn was 1/4 cent lower to 1-1/2 cents higher and soybeans were 1/4 cent lower to three cents higher.
